'''Valda''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he asked an Imperial to find and capture personnel of a destroyed Republic cruiser who had made it planetside in the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].
